entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to make a return. Order number is VF-886-21A. Can I do it, yes or no?

I can certainly look into that for you. One moment while I pull up that order... Okay, I see it's for the Pro-Series jersey. To make sure I get this right for you, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
It's the wrong size. The jersey is just way too tight. I need to get a bigger one or just get my money back. I'd prefer an exchange.
Understood. It's no problem at all when the fit isn't right. Let me just confirm the return eligibility based on our policy. One second...
Look, I got it about two weeks ago. Is it good or not?
Yes, absolutely. According to our system, standard apparel items like that jersey have a 10-day return window. You are unfortunately outside that period, so we can definitely process that for you.
Great. So what do I do?

I have just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email on file. You can use that to send the item back for a full refund. If you'd like an exchange for a different size, you can simply place a new order for the correct size at your convenience.
Fine. I have the email. Thanks.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
